outcome: Macronutrient content of human milk (fat, carbohydrate, protein, energy, lactose)
cohort: 102 women who gave birth by cesarean section or vaginal delivery
finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with significantly higher lactose levels in mature human milk compared to cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with significantly higher lactose levels in mature human milk compared to cesarean delivery.
